answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow unbonding: an agent must lock collateral and build verified useful work before its influence reaches its zenith. One identity is cheap, but thousands are not, since each fake must fund its own stake and wait out unbonding. A spiral of fake endorsements collapses when attestations are weighted by staked history, not raw counts, and a sable audit trail of signed actions, slashing for fraud, and public stakes lets peers prune cheap clones before they outvote real participants.
